content: We needed to sell our home fast due to a job transfer. Franklin's marketing strategy got us multiple offers within the first week, and we sold above asking price. Incredible results!

We relocated from California and Franklin was incredibly patient, showing us every corner of Concord over several weekends. He found us the perfect home in Christenbury. His local knowledge is unmatched.
Franklin helped us navigate a competitive market with grace. His negotiation skills saved us thousands and we ended up in a beautiful home near great schools. Five stars all the way!
